title: DependencyRationales
description: Flat overlay: per external workspace dependency, the rationale + owner + layer seam + replacement strategy. Joined with `cargo metadata --no-deps` output at lane time. Replaces the over-engineered tech-debt-ledger.json planned in original IP-002 (state machine + trigger DSL + monotonic graph DROPPED).

_meta.purpose: Documents each external workspace dependency rationale, owner, layer seam, and replacement strategy for policy gates.

anyhow.rationale: Error aggregation for CLI/tooling and application-edge orchestration where typed domain errors have already crossed the boundary. Domain/kernel crates should prefer explicit error enums.
anyhow.isolated_in_crate: tooling and application-edge crates; kernel/domain usage report-only

bytes.rationale: Byte buffer type for hyper bodies. After ADR-0092 Phase 2, only the adapter declares this dep; kernel uses Vec<u8> and the adapter converts at the boundary. Was previously leaked into oya-http-middleware-kernel + 3 middleware crates + ops-runtime — those leaks are CLOSED.

clap.rationale: Command-line parsing for developer/operator tooling. Product runtime libraries must not depend on CLI argument parsing.

http-body-util.rationale: Full<Bytes> body collector + Limited<B> bounded-collector. Limited is the load-bearing primitive for S3 unbounded-body DoS defense (ADR-0092 Phase 8).

hyper.rationale: HTTP I/O protocol — h1/h2 framing. Selected over axum/actix/poem per ADR-0090: bare protocol surface, smallest transitive cost. Workspace-wide directive 2026-05-14: hyper for framework; we build router/middleware/SSE ourselves above this layer.

hyper-rustls.rationale: Outbound TLS connector for the hyper-util legacy Client on the pooling-gateway upstream path (.omc/pooling-convergence.json slice 1). aws-lc-rs backend per ADR-0506 (ring is FORBIDDEN — default-features pull ring, so this is declared default-features=false with aws-lc-rs explicit); webpki-tokio trust anchors (webpki-roots) keep the trust store self-hostable with no OS native-certs dependency. h1+h2. The real provider-pool transport adapter consuming this lands in a LATER campaign slice; declared at the workspace seam now so the dep-seam + Cargo.lock land in one reviewed PR.

hyper-util.rationale: Tokio + auto-builder helpers for hyper. Adapter-local; no kernel exposure. Provides ConnBuilder used for slowloris-defense timeouts (ADR-0092 Phase 8 S4).

regex.rationale: Pattern validation in gates and developer tooling. Product hot paths should prefer parsers or bounded string checks unless an ADR names the regex boundary.

serde.rationale: Serialization framework. Used by adapters (DTOs), application orchestrators (event emission), and the application-shell frontend prototype's mock-only render-envelope DTO boundary. Kernels SHOULD NOT depend on serde — pure domain types don't carry serialization. (Some kernels currently do via convenience; the lane will report-only flag these as candidates for adapter-side DTO mapping per ADR-0092.) Managed-k8s SLA observability uses this dependency only for deterministic DTO serde/tests or async port tests; no live Prometheus/Kubernetes runtime is introduced.
serde.isolated_in_crate: adapter and application layer crates; kernel violations report-only

serde_json.rationale: JSON ser/de. Strictly adapter-layer except for the app-shell frontend prototype's local dev-server-to-WASM render-envelope boundary; kernel responses use hand-rolled formatting per 0-to-minimal-deps directive (see oya-ops-workspace-shell-runtime). The app-shell exception is mock-only, carries no PHI/PII/production tenant data, and does not establish a production backend/API readiness claim. Managed-k8s SLA observability uses this dependency only for deterministic DTO serde/tests or async port tests; no live Prometheus/Kubernetes runtime is introduced.

serde_yaml.rationale: YAML parsing for repository manifests, policies, and contract gates. Domain/kernel crates should not parse YAML directly.
serde_yaml.isolated_in_crate: oya-check-* lane crates and manifest tooling

tempfile.rationale: Temporary filesystem fixtures for tests and local tooling. Production kernels/domains should accept explicit paths or in-memory adapters.

tokio.layer_seam: adapter-only (current) + future async chain when ADR-0094 cancellation lands
tokio.rationale: Async runtime (rt-multi-thread + net). No realistic alternative for async HTTP server in Rust today. Adapter declares; ops-runtime indirectly via the adapter and #[tokio::main]. Managed-k8s SLA observability uses this dependency only for deterministic DTO serde/tests or async port tests; no live Prometheus/Kubernetes runtime is introduced.

toml.rationale: TOML reader (Cargo manifest parsing in lane crates). Tooling/lane only. Domain code must not consume TOML directly.

tracing.rationale: Span/event API. Used by observability adapter at infrastructure layer. Kernels and domains must NOT depend on tracing — pure types don't emit spans. Current usage is bounded.

tracing-subscriber.rationale: Subscriber registration. Should ONLY appear in composition-root (app) binaries — never in libraries — so binaries decide their own log routing.

walkdir.rationale: Repository filesystem traversal for gates/generators. Product runtime code should use explicit adapters and bounded traversals.
walkdir.isolated_in_crate: oya-check-* lane crates and tooling binaries

prost.rationale: Protocol Buffers message encode/decode traits used only by the generated backbone gRPC adapter crate. Domain/API/usecase kernels keep framework-free request/receipt types and explicit conversion seams.

protoc-bin-vendored.rationale: Pins a vendored protoc binary for reproducible compile-time descriptor/stub generation without relying on mutable CI host tool installation. Used only by the generated gRPC adapter build script.

sqlx.rationale: Async PostgreSQL client used only by SQLx adapter crates, the bounded transactional outbox worker composition root, and the env-gated foundry live workload harness app that proves tenant-scoped SQLx adapter behavior against disposable Postgres/Citus. Kernel/domain/usecase crates remain SQLx-free and expose typed command/outbox plans only.
sqlx.isolated_in_crate: oya-shared-postgres-command-adapter-sqlx, oya-shared-transactional-outbox-adapter-sqlx, oya-shared-transactional-outbox-worker-app, env-gated foundry live workload harness apps, and future *-adapter-postgres runtime crates only

tonic.rationale: Tonic codegen traits/types compile generated gRPC client/server bindings, and the isolated transport adapter enables local TCP server/client loopback tests over those generated bindings. Domain/kernel/usecase crates remain tonic-free.

tonic-prost.rationale: Prost codec type referenced by tonic 0.14 generated service bindings. Kept inside the generated adapter crate and not exposed to domain/usecase logic.

tonic-prost-build.rationale: Compile-time generator that bridges tonic service stub generation with prost message generation for source-controlled proto contracts. Used only in the generated adapter build script.

opentelemetry.rationale: Rust OpenTelemetry metrics API used only by the OTLP metrics adapter to construct canonical counters/gauges from the shared HyperscalerMetrics port. Domain/kernel/usecase crates remain OpenTelemetry-free.

opentelemetry-otlp.rationale: OTLP HTTP/protobuf metric exporter used behind an explicit environment gate for collector integration harnesses. It does not leak into microservice domain/API/usecase crates and no live export is claimed unless the operator enables the harness with a reachable collector.

opentelemetry_sdk.rationale: OpenTelemetry SDK MeterProvider used only by the OTLP metrics adapter to host instruments and periodic metric export. Composition roots opt in explicitly; pure layers remain SDK-free.

cedar-policy.rationale: AWS Cedar (Apache-2.0, OSI-clean) is the formally-verified authorization engine — default-deny, forbid-overrides-permit, order-independent (arXiv 2403.04651). ADR-0536 D-2 names Cedar the TERMINAL engine decision: the PDP is embedded in-process in every service via iam-pdp-cedar at iam/adapters/pdp-cedar (the shared embedded-PDP adapter behind the vendor-neutral oya-shared-pdp-kernel port), retiring the hand-rolled oya-policy-cedar evaluator (ADR-0243: two decision algorithms must never coexist). Domain/kernel crates stay Cedar-free and pass typed AuthorizationRequest/AuthorizationResponse across the boundary. Service-local authz-gate adapters (workload-identity, ci-webhook-gateway, cloud-intelligence, managed-k8s-tenant-quota) remain sanctioned until each migrates to the shared adapter. One sanctioned dev-only exception: oya-shared-platform-contracts-kernel declares cedar-policy strictly under [dev-dependencies] so its tests validate the checked-in FD-001 cedar/ schema + structural tenant-isolation seed against the real engine; its production surface stays Cedar-free.

kube.rationale: Kubernetes client (Client + dynamic Api) for the managed-k8s control-plane-host CAPI adapter (ADR-0376). Used only to talk to the management cluster's CAPI control-plane providers (Kamaji TenantControlPlane on controlplane.cluster.x-k8s.io; the dedicated Talos control-plane reference). The LIVE CRD reconciliation is honest-deferred per registry/placeholder-debt/adr-follow-ups.yaml#kamaji-provider-live-integration, so the adapter references kube-rs's dynamic surface and returns Unimplemented::KamajiProviderLiveIntegration instead of faking success. Kernel/api/inmemory crates stay kube-free.

kube-runtime.rationale: Kube controller-runtime primitives (watcher/reflector/Controller) for the managed-k8s control-plane-host CAPI adapter (ADR-0376). Adapter-only seam alongside kube; the live control-plane reconcile loop is honest-deferred (kamaji-provider-live-integration), so the dependency is the declared seam the follow-on ADR's controller will consume without a caller change.

k8s-openapi.rationale: Kubernetes API object types (ObjectMeta and core types referenced by the dynamic CAPI objects) for the managed-k8s control-plane-host CAPI adapter (ADR-0376). Adapter-only seam alongside kube; isolated to the -adapter-capi crate. Kernel/api/inmemory crates stay k8s-openapi-free.

clickhouse.rationale: ClickHouse 26.3 LTS HTTP client (Apache-2.0, OSI-clean). Provides async query execution and LZ4 compression for the OLAP analytics warehouse mandated by ADR-0193. Isolated exclusively to oya-shared-olap-clickhouse-adapter; no kernel, domain, usecase, or api crate may take this as a direct dependency. Matches manifest.json lts_pins.clickhouse=26.3.10.60-lts.

lane_contract.registry-coverage: Every name in [workspace.dependencies] (from cargo metadata) MUST appear in entries. Orphan rows in entries (deps removed from workspace) trigger warning.
lane_contract.layer-seam-check: For each entry, verify NO crate outside `isolated_in_crate` (or its compatible layer scope) declares or imports the dep.
lane_contract.cargo-audit-shell: Run `cargo audit`; pass if exit 0; flag CVE findings against entries for owner attention.

evolution_policy.add_dep: 0-ADR action: add an entry row alongside the [workspace.dependencies] line. Lane fails until row exists.
evolution_policy.remove_dep: 0-ADR action: remove the entry row alongside removing the workspace dep.
evolution_policy.change_layer_seam: 1-ADR action: tightening or loosening which layer may consume a dep requires an ADR. Loosening MUST cite a concrete need.
evolution_policy.cve_response: Owner team has 7 calendar days from CVE publication to either patch-bump the version_pin OR file an ADR exception with mitigation. CI tracks via cargo-audit-shell sub-check.

decision_log.what_changed: registry created with 11 seed entries; replaces over-engineered tech-debt-ledger from original IP-002
decision_log.why: Multispectrum F1 + F2 + F6: state machine + trigger DSL + monotonic transition graph are control plane for problems that don't exist at 11-dep scale. Flat 5-field-per-row overlay solves the actual problem (track + own + decide-removal-path per dep) in 50 lines instead of 500.

decision_log.what_changed: Reconciled registry coverage with the live [workspace.dependencies] roster: added anyhow/clap/tempfile/walkdir/serde_yaml/regex and removed orphan toml_edit.
decision_log.why: M01-P13-IP-002 closeout requires registry-coverage to be rerunnable against the current checkout instead of historical evidence only.

decision_log.what_changed: Authorized oya-application-shell-frontend-prototype for serde and serde_json only at its mock render-envelope DTO/local dev-server boundary.
decision_log.why: Current source serializes and hydrates a typed TenantRenderEnvelope between the SSR dev server and selective WASM island. The exception is narrow, mock-only, data-class INTERNAL_ONLY, and preserves the no-kernel/no-production-backend dependency seam required by ADR-0092.
